message: The briefing assumed data/historical_1m/ (task7b, task37, task46, task53, task54, task56, task61r, task63 subdirectories) exists in this isolated worktree, matching prior exploration of the canonical repo. It does not: /data/ is listed in .gitignore ('large, regenerable, provider-licensed... not something to version') as confirmed by grep of .gitignore line 46, so it was never a tracked git path. `git worktree add` only checks out tracked content; untracked/gitignored directories from the canonical worktree (c:\workspace\TalonX) are NOT copied into a new worktree automatically (unlike .env, which the task instructions confirm was manually copied). Verified: `data/` does not exist at all under c:\workspace\TalonX-alpha-phenomenon-discovery (checked via ls/find at repo root).
resolution: Did not read or copy from c:\workspace\TalonX (canonical worktree) per explicit instruction not to touch it at all. Instead: (1) data_inventory.json documents this gap honestly and inventories only what is actually materialized in this worktree (freshly downloaded DEVELOPMENT-role data + benchmarks), rather than fabricating entries for archives that do not exist here. (2) exposure_boundary_audit.json is built from git-tracked artifacts only (research/scripts/task*.py argument literals, results/task*/*.json date-range fields, docs/research/TALONX_RESEARCH_LEDGER.md) since those ARE tracked in git and available in this worktree, without needing the raw CSV bytes. (3) DEVELOPMENT-role data for the 35-symbol PIV universe was freshly downloaded via scripts/download_historical_1m.py (provider=alpaca, i.e. RESEARCH_SIP per this account's confirmed SIP entitlement from results/task63r_orpb_v1_feed_remediation/feed_diagnostic.json sip_available=true). NOTE (revised after the exposure audit completed): the audit found that literally every calendar date from 2025-01-24 through 2026-08-14 has SOME prior-task exposure for at least a symbol subset, so a genuinely postdating-and-clean DEVELOPMENT window does not exist within any practical size -- DEVELOPMENT was therefore deliberately drawn from the already-exposed 2026-05-15..2026-08-14 range (acceptable per the discovery plan's 'iteration allowed, nothing held out' rule for Discovery-phase data specifically), while VALIDATION/REPLICATION were instead reserved as FORWARD-LOOKING, not-yet-materialized calendar windows (2026-08-25 onward) to guarantee genuine non-exposure. See data_split_contract.md for the full reasoning.

message: First DEVELOPMENT download attempt failed immediately: KeyError: 'APCA_API_KEY_ID'. The script's fetch_alpaca() reads os.environ directly and never calls load_dotenv() itself (unlike e.g. research/scripts/task63r_probe_alpaca_feeds.py, which does `load_dotenv(ROOT / '.env', override=False)` explicitly) -- simply having a .env file in the worktree root is not sufficient; the caller must export the credentials into the process environment before invoking this script.
resolution: Re-ran with `export $(grep -E "^APCA_API_KEY_ID=|^APCA_API_SECRET_KEY=" .env | xargs) && python scripts/download_historical_1m.py ...` -- succeeded, 35/35 symbols FULL status, 1,376,385 bars, exit code 0. Same export pattern reused for the SPY/sector-ETF benchmark download (8/8 succeeded, 252,971 bars, exit code 0). No code was modified to fix this -- it was a caller-side invocation issue, not a bug in the downloader worth patching for this task's scope.
